objective: Selective prediction: confirmed/rejected/unresolved drift with independent step estimate, preserve unresolved rather than forcing binary decisions

pilot.warning: Pilot observed before freeze; cannot count toward fresh holdout.

frozen_parameters.drift_measure: Median pairwise slopes between ten-sample bin medians, with pre/post split at greatest step candidate
frozen_parameters.abstentions: Unresolved must remain in ledger and cannot be counted as correct prediction

holdout.criteria: Report decided-correct, decided-wrong, unresolved and exact step localization. No changes after freeze.

limitations: Synthetic retrospective detector and defined noise family
Unresolved is not a correct prediction
Pilot-informed bands; no guaranteed confidence coverage
No direct external mathematical theorem provenance claims
